message.content: Terima kasih atas pertanyaannya! Apakah yang Anda maksud adalah bahwa celana seamless tidak memiliki tiga jahitan (atau potongan) pada bagian tertentu? Jika iya, maka benar—desain celana seamless memang dibuat tanpa jahitan yang terlihat, sehingga tidak ada tiga potongan atau jahitan yang mencolok. Namun, beberapa model mungkin masih memiliki satu garis kecil di pinggang untuk penyesuaian ukuran. Mohon konfirmasi kembali agar saya dapat memberikan informasi yang lebih tepat.
message.reasoning:
The user says: "Mau konfirm yg celana seemless nya nga ada tiga2". This appears to be Indonesian or Malay. Rough translation: "I want to confirm that the seamless pants don't have three [something]". Possibly they mean "I want to confirm that the seamless pants do not have three seams" or "I want to confirm that the seamless pants don't have three [holes]"? They might be asking about a product detail: "celana seamless" means seamless pants. "nga ada tiga2" maybe "doesn't have three"? Could be "doesn't have three holes" or "doesn't have three seams"? They might be asking for confirmation that the seamless pants do not have three seams.

We need to respond appropriately. We can ask clarifying question: "Apakah maksud Anda celana seamless tidak memiliki tiga jahitan?" Or we can answer: "Ya, celana seamless memang dirancang tanpa adanya tiga jahitan." But we should ask for clarification. Also we could mention that seamless pants typically have no visible seams, but some may have small seam at waist. So we can say: "Celana seamless biasanya tidak memiliki tiga jahitan, hanya satu di pinggang atau tidak sama sekali."

Thus we respond politely.
